gloss: sales office; business office; branch office

definitions.gloss: sales office; business office; (local) branch office
definitions.explanation: A local office of a company that handles sales, customer service, or regional operations — typically smaller than a headquarters or {支店|してん} (branch), and often focused on logistics, pickups, deliveries, or regional clients. Common for shipping companies, utilities, and sales-driven businesses.

examples.japanese: {近|ちか}くの{営業所|えいぎょうしょ}に{電話|でんわ}した。
examples.english: I called the nearest branch office.

examples.japanese: {荷物|にもつ}は{最寄|もよ}りの{営業所|えいぎょうしょ}で{受|う}け{取|と}れます。
examples.english: You can pick up the package at your nearest branch office.

examples.japanese: {新規|しんき}{取引|とりひき}のため、{大阪|おおさか}の{営業所|えいぎょうしょ}で{打|う}ち{合|あ}わせを{行|おこな}った。
examples.english: For the new business deal, we held a meeting at the Osaka branch office.

notes:
Composed of {営業|えいぎょう} (business, sales) and {所|しょ} (place). Most Japanese learners first encounter the word with delivery companies — {宅配|たくはい}{便|びん} companies like {ヤマト{運輸|うんゆ}} or {佐川急便|さがわきゅうびん} call their local pickup/drop-off centers {営業所|えいぎょうしょ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {最寄|もよ}りの{営業所|えいぎょうしょ}: the nearest branch office
- {営業所|えいぎょうしょ}に{問|と}い{合|あ}わせる: to make an inquiry at the branch office
- {営業所|えいぎょうしょ}{止|ど}め: "hold at branch office" (for package delivery)
- {大阪|おおさか}{営業所|えいぎょうしょ}: the Osaka branch office
- {営業所|えいぎょうしょ}{長|ちょう}: branch office manager

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {支店|してん}: branch (of a chain store, bank, etc.) — typically larger and more full-service than a {営業所|えいぎょうしょ}
- {本社|ほんしゃ}: head office, headquarters
- {事業所|じぎょうしょ}: business establishment — a broader legal/accounting term covering any workplace of a company
- {出張所|しゅっちょうじょ}: sub-office, local outlet — usually smaller than a {営業所|えいぎょうしょ}
